title: 南浦别
author: 白居易
intro: An autumn farewell by the water in twenty simple characters: every look back breaks the heart, so — go well, and don’t turn around.
analysis: “南浦”本义是南边的水边，自从古代楚辞里写“送美人兮南浦”，它就成了送别地点的代称。第一、二句写环境：在南浦凄凉地分别，秋天的西风轻轻吹着。“凄凄”“袅袅”两个叠词，读起来缓慢绵长，就像离别时舍不得走的心情。第三句很特别：“一看肠一断”——每回头看一次，心就碎一次。第四句于是劝对方：“好好走吧，别回头了！”不回头不是不在乎，而是太在乎，怕再看一眼更难分开。语言像说话一样朴素，却把离别的痛写得很真。
analysisEn: 南浦 literally means “the southern shore”. Ever since an ancient Chu poem said “I see you off at the southern shore”, the phrase has stood for any place of farewell, the way “the station platform” might in English. The first two lines set the scene: a sad parting by the water, an autumn west wind blowing softly. The doubled words 凄凄 (“mournful”) and 袅袅 (“gently drifting”) slow the rhythm down, like people who can’t bring themselves to leave. Line 3 is striking: 一看肠一断, “one look, one broken heart” — every time the traveller looks back, the heart breaks again (Chinese speaks of the “gut” breaking with grief). So line 4 urges: “Go well — don’t look back!” Not looking back doesn’t mean not caring; it means caring so much that one more glance would make parting impossible. The language is as plain as everyday speech, yet it gets the pain of saying goodbye exactly right.
background: Bai Juyi (772–846) was famous for writing poems so plain that, legend says, he read them to an old woman and revised any line she couldn’t understand. When and to whom he wrote this farewell is not known.
pronunciation: 袅袅 niǎo niǎo；好去 hǎo（好好地去）；“一看”按今音读 kàn，格律上此处为平声（旧读 kān）。

lines.lit: At the southern shore, a mournful parting;
lines.en: A sad farewell at the southern shore;

lines.lit: the west wind drifts softly — autumn.
lines.en: the west wind softly stirs the autumn air.

lines.lit: One look, the gut breaks once;
lines.en: Each look back breaks my heart again,

lines.lit: go well, do not turn your head.
lines.en: so go well — and don’t turn around.

words.en: the southern shore — a place of farewell
words.note: “浦”是水边；古诗里代指送别的地方。
中国的秋风从西边来，诗里“西风”常指秋风。
现代汉语“炊烟袅袅”还用。
现代汉语有“肝肠寸断”“断肠”。
古代送别用语，现代汉语说“一路平安”“慢走”。
古义，现代汉语说“别”“不要”。

imagery.name: 南浦
imagery.zh: 南浦是送别的地方，一开头就点明这是一场离别。
imagery.en: The southern shore is the classic place of farewell — the very first word tells us someone is leaving.

imagery.name: 秋风
imagery.zh: 袅袅的西风带出秋天的萧瑟，衬托离别的凄凉。
imagery.en: The soft west wind of autumn adds a chill of loneliness to the parting.
